name: asciiFlags
desc: Classification flags for an ASCII code point.

name: controlCodeRegExp
desc: Matches any ANSI escape code that isn't a style code.

name: copyToClipboard
desc: Copies text to the user's clipboard.

name: cursorDown
desc: Moves the cursor down by lines rows.

name: cursorLeft
desc: Moves the cursor left by columns.

name: cursorRight
desc: Moves the cursor right by columns.

name: cursorTo
desc: Moves the cursor to row and column on the screen.

name: cursorToColumn
desc: Moves the cursor to column on the current line.

name: cursorToLineAbove
desc: Moves the cursor to the start of a line lines rows above.

name: cursorToLineBelow
desc: Moves the cursor to the start of a line lines rows below.

name: cursorUp
desc: Moves the cursor up by lines rows.

name: delay
desc: A delayed future of however many seconds

name: graphemeFlags
desc: Classification flags for a grapheme.

name: graphemes
desc: Splits string into user-perceived characters (grapheme clusters).

name: hyperlink
desc: Makes text a clickable link that opens url.

name: isNonPrintable
desc: Whether rune is a code point that is not visible when printed.

name: kBAR_EIGHTHS
desc: Blocks from 1/8 to full width, for smooth progress bars.

name: kBAR_LEVELS
desc: Blocks from empty to full height, for little bar charts (sparklines).

name: kSPINNER_ARC
desc: An arc going round a circle: ◜◠◝◞◡◟.

name: kSPINNER_BOUNCE
desc: A dot bouncing up and down: ⠁⠂⠄⠂.

name: kSPINNER_CIRCLE
desc: A circle filling up from each side in turn: ◐◓◑◒.

name: kSPINNER_FRAMES
desc: The default spinner: braille dots going round.

name: kSPINNER_LINE
desc: A spinner made from plain keyboard characters: | / - \.

name: notify
desc: Pops up a desktop notification with message.

name: scrollDown
desc: Scrolls the screen content down by lines, adding blank lines at the top.

name: scrollRegion
desc: Limits scrolling to the rows from top to bottom.

name: scrollUp
desc: Scrolls the screen content up by lines, adding blank lines at the bottom.

name: styleCodeRegExp
desc: Matches an ANSI style code, like \x1B[31m or \x1B[1;38;5;196m.

name: taskbarError
desc: Like taskbarProgress, but shown in red to say something failed.

name: taskbarPaused
desc: Like taskbarProgress, but shown in yellow to say it is paused.

name: taskbarProgress
desc: Shows percent (0 to 100) as progress on the terminal tab and taskbar.

name: windowTitle
desc: Sets the title of the terminal window or tab.
